scope: Public deterministic SOURCE-ONLY model recipe; synthetic IDs grant no live authority and are not production trust pins
id_qualification: Literal preselected synthetic ID values only. Account/provision/retention/source-binding identifiers model exact shape and relational binding, not an issued receipt, runtime, encrypted envelope, opaque capability or actual authority.

id_sequence_rule.encoding: unsigned integer to lowercase hexadecimal, left-zero-padded to 64; disjoint starts below; nonzero; source-only synthetic IDs

event_rule.encoding: Same 64-lowercase-hex id_sequence_rule with event sequence start; raw provider EventID remains distinct from derived account Barrier.EventID

initial_manifest_rule: Use each exact inherited public actual-manifest immutable identity/profile fields and independently inherited DefaultAccounts zero cursors for all eight branches. Keep actual native84 1/1 copy distinct and apply it as a capture, never relabel old vault vectors with nonzero cursors as initial DefaultAccounts.

semantics.provider_timestamp_ms: floor(sample_ms/1000)*1000 for immutable authenticated_at_ms/verified_at_ms; JWT integer seconds; driver clock retains full sampled milliseconds
semantics.config_order: IdentityConfig Accounts.Principals sorted by independently derived inherited PrincipalID; fixture arrays remain zero256 then incrementing256
semantics.publication: State-machine labels and arithmetic only. Actual fence, key clear, filesystem identity, crash, sync/rename/link and cleanup effects require implementation fault injection.
